§6Desh§f

§aNine rare earth metals forged into a superalloy that refuses to break  -  unbreakable tools, advanced machines, and radiation shielding!§f

Desh is a fictional superalloy made from nine rare earth metals: Boron, Lanthanum (x2), Lithium, Cobalt, Neodymium, Cerium, and Niobium. It has extreme blast, heat, and corrosion resistance, and actually shields against radiation.

§6Making it§f:
§b•§f Craft §bDesh Blend§f from 9 rare earth powders (shapeless), or get it from asteroid mining.
§b•§f Chemical Plant: §e1×§f Desh Blend + §e200mB§f Mercury + §e200mB§f Light Oil yields §e1×§f Desh Ingot.
§b•§f Ore Acidizer: DeshReady Blend + §e500mB§f Hydrogen Peroxide yields ingot.

§6Key uses§f:
§b•§f Desh Compound Plate (Tier 3 Anvil) for machines and missiles.
§b•§f Unbreakable tools with iron harvest level.
§b•§f Fracking Tower components.

§ePS:§f Mercury comes from centrifuging redstone. Light Oil is an early refinery product. Both are prerequisites!
